instructions:
This vector index must be created manually in MongoDB Atlas:

1. Go to MongoDB Atlas > Your Cluster > Collections
2. Select Database: edureach_db, Collection: knowledge_docs
3. Click 'Indexes' tab
4. Click 'Create Index'
5. Select 'Vector Search'
6. Set Index Name: edureach_vector_index
7. Set Vector Field Path: embedding
8. Set Dimensions: 768 (for embedding-001 model)
9. Set Similarity: cosine
10. Click 'Create Index'

Alternatively, use MongoDB Atlas CLI or API to create the index.

Note: The knowledge_docs collection will be auto-created with documents when the backend initializes.
